posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Welcome, Sentinels fans! Here's the place to discuss the ongoing Freedom Four Annual comic that we're putting up a page at a time here on our website!

I know that many of you have already seen the comic as part of the Infernal Relics and Enhanced Edition kickstarter, but please do not spoil things for the readers who haven't seen the whole thing yet. Don't discuss things which haven't happened yet! Thank you.

So, enjoy your discussions, share your tales of the Multiverse, and keep reading! Thanks!
